thesis: Annie Duke argues that while experience is necessary for becoming a better decision maker, it is not sufficient because the paradox of experience and hindsight bias can interfere with learning. She proposes that to overcome these issues, one must embrace counterfactual thinking to properly evaluate decision-making processes.
